channels_note: Mention it from the feed you already post on. Same bot, same catalog, same answer — the channel only changes where the reply lands.
chains_note: Name a chain in the mention and the launch is routed there. If a route cannot complete, it says so before a single lamport is spent.

roadmap.title: A mention becomes a token
items: Live on Solana mainnet — coins created, confirmed on chain, tradeable
Your token trades against a tokenized stock, not against SOL
80/20 creator split written into the launch transaction, not promised for later
Around a dollar per launch, measured on real launches, not estimated
One mention can only ever make one token, even if it arrives twice

roadmap.title: Ask however you talk
items: The model reads the request, the code approves it — Portuguese, English, typos and all
Got the ticker wrong? It shows what it thinks you meant and waits for a yes
Every tokenized stock is known: the thin ones come back named, with their number
Live on Discord, Telegram and X — one mention, wherever you already are
Reddit, Instagram and TikTok in final testing

roadmap.title: Pick your chain
items: Solana through pump.fun and StonkFun, Robinhood Chain through Pons, BNB through four.meme
Name the chain in the mention and the route follows — no dashboard, no second step
Say nothing and it picks the route that can actually deliver right now
A route that cannot complete is refused out loud, before any spend
Same 80/20 split on every chain, enforced by the contract, not by us

roadmap.title: Holders get paid, provably
items: Creator fees buy the paired asset and settle to holders on a schedule anyone can check
A basket, not one name: up to five assets, weights fixed at launch and never editable
Every payout posted as a transaction, linked from the coin's own page
A reward the buyer can price before buying, because the rules cannot change after

roadmap.title: Creators get paid
items: Bind a wallet to your handle once — every coin you launch pays into it
Claim your share straight from the mention that made the coin
A page per creator: what you launched, what it earned, what is claimable
Launch limits per handle, so one account cannot flood a feed

roadmap.title: Anyone can run it
items: A public API: the same launch path the bot uses, opened up
Drop the launcher into your own community under your own name
Pick the launchpad by what it costs and what it can do, not by what we wired first
More pairs as more real-world assets get tokenized — the catalog finds them itself
